title: Bias-robust causal inference for panel data
abstract: arXiv:2608.09837v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We develop a bias-robust framework for causal inference in panel data models with interactive fixed effects. Conventional imputation-based estimators of average treatment effects on the treated do not explicitly account for counterfactual approximation error, potentially leading to misleading inference. Building on bias-aware minimax methods, we construct an estimator that corrects imputed counterfactuals using weighted untreated residuals and delivers confidence intervals with an explicit allowance for the remaining approximation bias. The resulting framework separates protection against approximation bias from the efficiency gains obtained through optimal correction. In simulations, the correction reduces confidence interval length by approximately 13\% relative to bias-aware inference without correction, while preserving empirical coverage. translated_title: 面板数据的偏差稳健因果推断
translated_abstract: 我们为具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型的因果推断开发了一个偏差稳健框架。传统的基于填补方法的受处理者平均处理效应估计量并未显式考虑反事实近似误差，可能导致误导性推断。基于偏差感知的极小化极大方法，我们构建了一个估计量，该估计量利用加权的未处理残差对填补的反事实进行校正，并提供了显式考虑剩余近似偏差的置信区间。由此得到的框架将对近似偏差的保护与通过最优校正获得的效率提升分离开来。在模拟实验中，相较于未校正的偏差感知推断，该校正方法使置信区间长度缩短约13%，同时保持了经验覆盖率。对选举日登记（Election Day Registration）的应用展示了该校正方法如何加强……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文为具有交互固定效应的面板数据模型提出了一个偏差稳健的因果推断框架，通过利用加权未处理残差校正填补的反事实并显式考虑剩余近似偏差，在保持经验覆盖率的同时将置信区间长度缩短约13%。
